$note: Heuristic keyword-scan taxonomy built from the 60 characters/<slug>.json files (kit skills, rotation, communityNotes, teams notes) already scraped from Prydwen.gg per SOURCES_STATUS.md. Each row cites the character slug and the JSON section the keyword was found in; open characters/<slug>.json for the full sentence and exact numeric value where the source page gave one. This is a categorization pass, not a re-scrape — where Prydwen's own text did not state a number or duration, none is invented here (see each character file's own prose for what precision exists).
methodology: Scanned kit.intro, kit.skills.*, rotation, communityNotes, and teams[].notes in every character JSON for category keywords (e.g. 'DMG Bonus/Amp/Deepen', 'Crit Rate', 'RES Shred', 'Heal', 'Concerto'/'Resonance Energy'). Terminology aligned with app/src/features/teams/calcEngine.js's CHAR_BUFF_TABLE stat vocabulary (allDmg, elemDmg, skillDmg, basicDmg, libDmg, critRate, critDmg, defShred, deepen) so this layer stays consumable by the same engine later.

elementalDmgBonus.description: Buffs to a specific element's DMG% (Havoc/Spectro/Aero/Glacio/Fusion/Electro DMG Bonus, Amp, or Deepen) — the largest single buff category in the kit set. Typically granted via Outro Skill (target: next resonator) or Liberation, occasionally as an always-on Inherent Skill.
reliesOnArchetypes: Hypercarry (single Main DPS, buffers rotate through to feed one element)
Mono-element teams (e.g. Mono Fusion, Mono Aero)
